name: offside_lone_upfield_car
description: Blue car 1000 uu upfield of a resting ball, nobody covering. By hand: upfield beyond the 200 uu dead zone = 800, severity 800/800 = 1.0, team factor 1 (last man), so -1.0 per step. Orange is goalside of the ball.

expect.intent: a lone car 1000 uu upfield of the ball pays -1.0 every step (severity 1.0, nobody covering)
the blue car is offside on every step
the orange car is goalside of the ball and pays nothing
